scripts.dev: npm run build:main && npm run copy:assets && concurrently -k -n main,renderer,tsc "electron ." "vite --config vite.config.ts" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run copy:assets
scripts.copy:assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const src='assets'; const dst='dist/main/assets'; fs.cpSync(src, dst, {recursive: true});"
